knowledge:
- key_parameters: phenoData=An AnnotatedDataFrame containing well metadata passed to parseRTCA or assigned via phenoData(x) <- ;; base-time=The specific time point (e.g., 35) passed to ratioTransform to normalize cell index values across wells ;; time=The numeric time point passed to addAction to record experimental events ;; action=The character string describing the event passed to addAction
- alternatives: ratioTransform=The default normalization strategy used by the commercial software, which divides cell index values by the value at a base-time ;; smoothTransform=Fits a cubic smoothing spline to smooth curves, useful for visualization ;; interpolationTransform=Interpolates data to regular intervals, required for certain time-series models ;; derivativeTransform=Calculates the first derivative against time to estimate growth rate without requiring an arbitrary base-time ;; rgrTransform=Calculates relative growth rate by dividing the first derivative by the raw value at each time point
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing real-time cell viability, proliferation, adhesion, or morphology data generated by Roche xCELLigence RTCA systems, especially when custom transformations, timeline annotations, or plate-wide visualizations are required.
- pitfalls: ratioTransform is highly sensitive to the choice of base-time, which can dramatically alter the shape of the normalized curve. ratioTransform also distorts variance, making it very small near the base-time and larger as time increases, which may violate assumptions of downstream statistical tests. smoothTransform must be used with caution if statistical modeling or hypothesis testing is performed afterward.

workflows.name: rtca_import_annotate_and_visualize
workflows.intent: Import raw RTCA data, annotate wells with experimental metadata, manage timeline events, and visualize cell index curves.
workflows.stages: 1. Parse the raw RTCA data file ;; 2. Read and format phenotype metadata ;; 3. Assign metadata to the RTCA object ;; 4. Plot individual well curves ;; 5. Add experimental actions to the timeline ;; 6. Generate a plate-wide visualization
workflows.code:
ofile <-  system.file("extdata/testOutput.csv", package="RTCA")
x <- parseRTCA(ofile)
pfile <- system.file("extdata/testOutputPhenoData.csv", package="RTCA")
pData <- read.csv(pfile, sep="\t", row.names="Well")
metaData <- data.frame(labelDescription=c(
                         "Rack number",
                         "siRNA catalogue number",
                         "siRNA gene symbol",
                         "siRNA EntrezGene ID",
                         "siRNA targeting accession"
                         ))
phData <- new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data=pData, varMetadata=metaData)
phenoData(x) <- phData
plot(x[,1:4], type="l", col="black", lty=1:4, xlab="time point", ylab="Cell Index")
x <- addAction(x, 22, "trasfection")
x <- addAction(x, 30, "medium change")
timeline(x)
plateView(x, col="orange")

workflows.name: rtca_data_transformation
workflows.intent: Apply mathematical transformations to RTCA cell index data to prepare for statistical analysis and modeling.
workflows.stages: 1. Parse raw data with phenotype metadata ;; 2. Apply ratio transformation ;; 3. Apply smooth transformation ;; 4. Apply interpolation transformation ;; 5. Apply derivative transformation ;; 6. Apply relative growth rate transformation
workflows.code:
ofile <-  system.file("extdata/testOutput.csv", package="RTCA")
pfile <- system.file("extdata/testOutputPhenoData.csv", package="RTCA")
pData <- read.csv(pfile, sep="\t", row.names="Well")
metaData <- data.frame(labelDescription=c(
                         "Rack number",
                         "siRNA catalogue number",
                         "siRNA gene symbol",
                         "siRNA EntrezGene ID",
                         "siRNA targeting accession"
                         ))
phData <- new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data=pData, varMetadata=metaData)
x <- parseRTCA(ofile, phenoData=phData)
xRatio <- ratioTransform(x, 35)
xSmooth <- smoothTransform(x)
xInter <- interpolationTransform(x)
xDeriv <- derivativeTransform(x)
xRgr <- rgrTransform(x)
